description: Authoritative timing settings. All values are seconds. Run python3 tools/sync_timing.py after editing; see docs/TIMING.md.

sensor_read_interval.description: Pi: wait after each sensor read before reading that sensor again.

sensor_read_timeout.description: Pi: maximum wait for one hardware read.

sensor_retry_max.description: Pi: maximum per-sensor exponential retry delay.

sensor_worker_poll.description: Pi: poll the sensor worker and process exit status.

sensor_worker_stop_timeout.description: Pi: wait after terminate, then after kill.

sensor_blocked_retry.description: Pi: retry cleanup when a hardware worker cannot exit.

sensor_loop_pause.description: Pi: pause between scans of due sensors.

gateway_poll_interval.description: AWS: wait between completed Pi refreshes.

gateway_retry_max.description: AWS: maximum exponential retry delay after refresh failures.

pi_request_timeout.description: AWS: total deadline for each Pi read or control request.

relay_schedule_check_interval.description: Pi: evaluate relay schedules at this interval; also checked at startup.

sensor_stale_after.description: All components: maximum healthy sensor reading age.

gateway_stale_after.description: AWS: maximum age of cached Pi state.

browser_state_poll_interval.description: Browser: fetch current AWS state while visible.

browser_clock_interval.description: Browser: update displayed clock and freshness status.

browser_state_stale_after.description: Browser: maximum age since a successful state fetch.

browser_schedule_confirmation_timeout.description: Browser: deadline to confirm saved settings through refreshed state.

browser_events_poll_interval.description: Browser: refresh event history while visible.

browser_feeding_poll_interval.description: Browser: refresh feeding settings while visible.

browser_feeding_stale_after.description: Browser: maximum age of feeding settings.

history_sample_interval.description: AWS: sample cached readings for historical storage.
